correctness.rationale: Lower bound C*>=14 is a valid proof: D has 66 divisors >=7 of 10080 (recomputed, matches draft list). Max reciprocal sum over k-subsets is attained at k smallest divisors since 1/d decreasing. Exact Fractions recomputed: sum 13 smallest = 1669/1680 ~=0.99345 <=1, sum 14 smallest = 115/112 ~=1.02679 >1, total 29/20=1.45. Density <= sum and strict sum>1 necessary for distinct cover (Mirsky-Newman); k<=13 max <=1 so impossible. Upper bound C*<=65 is verified by computation: 65 moduli distinct, all divide 10080, min exactly 7, LCM exactly 10080, all residues 0<=a<m valid, exhaustive replay over Z_10080 covers 10080/10080 (ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> VERIFY_OK). Histogram recomputed: 1:5926, 2:3785, 3:365, 4:4, sum 10080, all 65 classes have >=1 private residue (min 1 for 2016/3360/10080, max 736 for mod 8), missing modulus vs D is exactly 1120, consistent with claimed deletion of (233 mod 1120). Covering mod L0 implies covering Z since all moduli divide L0. Draft honestly limits scope: C* not closed, gap open, no claim 64 impossible, irredundancy only for stated residues not global minimality, heuristic re-optimization 9524-9796/10080 explicitly labeled heuristic not proof. No essential inference error or boundary violation; proof (density + exhaustive replay) distinguished from heuristic.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Harrington et al. arXiv:2605.18644 (directly fetched) treats LCMs 2^a3^b5^c with a>=b>=c, classifies m=2..6 (except one m=6 case), proves m<=9, gives m=8 example; prime universe excludes 7 so L0=10080=2^5*3^2*5*7 is outside its scope, no m=7 divisor-of-10080 cardinality optimum. Zhang et al. arXiv:2607.19029 per admission proves Lmin(7)=10080 and exhibits one 66-class feasible system optimizing LCM, not number of congruences, with no smaller-k exclusion or cardinality table; draft credits Zhang and claims only single-class redundancy (1120 removable) plus exact 14-pairing as new. Balister 2211.01417 (distortion bounds) and 1904.04806 (asymptotic counts) give general/asymptotic results, no fixed-window exact C* witness. arXiv API queries for cardinality/minimal-cardinality returned no competing table. The 65-subsystem covering claim (remaining 65 still cover) is factually distinct from the published 66-system and not implied by LCM minimality; reciprocal-sum 14 computation alone is standard but paired interval is not previously tabulated. Hence headline interval/witness is new relative to nearest priors.

value.rationale: Strongest headline actually delivered is C* in [14,65] with an irredundant 65-cover; exact C* and promised fallback complete minimal-size table over divisors of 2520 are both admittedly undelivered (draft Sec.3: gap 14..65 open, no 64-impossibility). Lower bound 14 is textbook density arithmetic over fixed divisors, mechanically reproducible. Upper bound 65 is a one-class deletion from the published Zhang 66-system (missing modulus exactly 1120); testing all 66 single deletions by CRT replay over 10080 residues is milliseconds and mechanically discoverable by anyone holding the published system, verified here in one replay run. Gap width 51 leaves no exact invariant: C* undetermined, no minimality certificate, no census, no located gaps. Irredundancy proved is inclusion-minimality for fixed residues (each class owns a private residue), explicitly not global cardinality minimality, so not the promised cheapest-cover benchmark. Heuristic trials after dropping large moduli are admitted non-proofs. A future researcher already possessing Zhang's 66-system gains only 66->65 saving with no closure toward C*, reusable only as a marginally smaller feasible example, not a citable extremal optimum or atlas anchor. Certification (VERIFY_OK) alone does not rescue a tiny incremental tweak plus textbook bound. This is a missing substantive result / tiny unmotivated gain, not a narrow-but-exact motivated invariant whose value was unknown and non-mechanical.
